data.name: Circular Carbon Pathways
data.description: Circular Carbon Pathways (CCP) is a Zambia-based early-stage biochar project developer producing biochar carbon removal (BCR) credits from agricultural residues. The company is a cohort member of the Carbon Removal Foundation's remove.global accelerator, which lists it as a "project developer and operator of vetted high-integrity biochar carbon removal projects." Public footprint remains minimal — tagline-only website, ~2 LinkedIn employees, no registry issuances yet.
